scope: Offline next-work selection only; no worktree, pool, research, source approval or installation created.
owner_authority: 2026-10-19: Keep the cache warm; continue automatically. Source-only adoption and all existing source-quality gates remain.

priority_decision.rationale: Common child/home/animal/body diminutives remain unowned typed strings while their literal parent concepts already serve. Select33bounded existing-owner lexical families rather than new duplicate size/age nodes. Seven concrete plant/bird/body heads have a current selected-sense four-link skeleton with no batch dependency. These are provisional hypotheses, not source/paradigm approval; preserve all holds and reduce unsupported families without replacements.
priority_decision.existing_stock_priority: The62-family/101-key narrower morphology stock remains a curation/integration priority, not authority to install or repeat its source work. Diminutives/subtypes retain their classification and exact owner.
priority_decision.backlog_extension: Common literal diminutive inputs and a bounded concrete plant/bird/body gap; no claim of exhaustive coverage.

method: Offline current/live/accepted/held/legacy exact-head and related-sense screening, followed by explicit actual-owner metadata and graph-skeleton checks.
A selected head is no approval/reservation. Step1 still screens every planned noncolliding family and connection before any web source call.
Existing-owner aliases change no metadata, add no new node/graph claims and cannot steal other-sense/deferred forms. Distinguish literal diminutives, age/size subtypes, synonyms and regional inputs.
New node skeletons meet unchanged4–8links/2old-main/2same-category/<=2batch constraints using actual current endpoints; no source truth or playable target is inferred.
